source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the Chapter 15 exercise solved (PDF 57-59), MCQ keys, model answers and worked numericals; the book prints no answers.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 15 (Physical Optics) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short aur constructed response sawalon ke model jawab aur numerical problems ka step-by-step hal diya gaya hai. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)
Choose the correct answer. (Sahi jawab chunein.)

blocks.prompt:
15.1 When the light from two lamps falls on a screen, no interference pattern can be obtained. Why is this?
(Jab do lampon ki roshni screen par parti hai to interference pattern nahin banta. Kyun?)

options.text: Lamp mukhtalif amplitudes ki roshni dete hain.
Lampon ki roshni coherent (ek jaisa phase farq rakhne wali) nahin hai.

blocks.explanation: Interference ke liye coherent sources (jin ka phase difference hamesha ek jaisa rahe) chahiye. Do alag lamp apni roshni random tukron mein dete hain, phase difference badalta rehta hai, is liye pattern itni tezi se badalta hai ke nazar nahin aata; sirf yaksaan roshni dikhti hai.

blocks.prompt:
15.2 Monochromatic light illuminates two narrow parallel slits. The interference pattern which results is observed on a screen some distance beyond the slits. Which change increases the separation between the dark lines of the interference pattern?
(Monochromatic (ek rang ki) roshni do patli parallel slits par parti hai aur screen par interference pattern dekha jata hai. Kaun si tabdeeli dark lines ke darmiyan faasla barhati hai?)

options.text: Screen aur slits ka faasla kam karna
Lambi wavelength wali monochromatic roshni istemal karna

blocks.explanation: Fringe ka faasla Δy = Lλ/d. Lambi wavelength se Δy barhta hai. L kam karna, d barhana ya zyada frequency (chhoti λ) fringes ko qareeb kar deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
15.3 Using monochromatic light, interference fringes are produced on a screen placed a distance L from a pair of slits of separation d. The separation of the fringes is y. Both d and L are now doubled. What is the new fringe separation?
(Screen slits se L faasle par hai, slits ka darmiyani faasla d hai aur fringes ka faasla y hai. d aur L dono double kar diye jayen to naya fringe faasla kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Δy = Lλ/d. Naya faasla = (2L)λ/(2d) = Lλ/d = y, yani faasla wohi rehta hai.

blocks.prompt:
15.4 Which of the following is not a necessary condition for two waves to produce interference.
(In mein se kaun si shart interference ke liye zaroori NAHIN hai?)

options.text: Waves ek hi qisam ki hon
Waves ek hi simt (direction) mein chal rahi hon

blocks.explanation: Chapter ki sharait: waves ek qisam ki hon, coherent hon, aur ek hi (ya taqreeban ek) simt mein chalen. Mukhtalif amplitude wali waves bhi interference karti hain; sirf pattern ka contrast (roshan aur andheri jagah ka farq) kam hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
15.5 The colours appeared on a soap bubble are due to which phenomenon of light?
(Sabun ke bulbule par nazar aane wale rang roshni ke kis amal ki wajah se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Patli sabun ki film ki aglay aur pichhlay surface se reflect hone wali roshni interference karti hai; har wavelength alag motai par mazboot hoti hai, is liye rang nazar aate hain (15.6).

blocks.prompt:
15.6 Continuous water waves are diffracted through a gap in a barrier in a ripple tank. Which change will cause the diffraction of the waves to increase?
(Ripple tank mein paani ki lehrein barrier ke gap se diffract hoti hain. Kaun si tabdeeli diffraction barhaye gi?)
blocks.explanation: Diffraction (phailao) sab se zyada tab hota hai jab gap ki chaurai wavelength ke barabar ho. Gap chhota karne se phailao barhta hai; frequency barhane ya wavelength kam karne se ghatta hai.

blocks.prompt:
15.7 Which property of a light wave can be determined using a diffraction grating?
(Diffraction grating se roshni ki kaun si khasiyat maloom ki ja sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: d sin θ = nλ se: grating spacing d maloom ho aur order n ka angle θ naapa jaye to wavelength λ bohat durust maloom hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
15.8 The central maximum in a diffraction grating is called:
(Diffraction grating mein beech wala (central) maximum kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Central maximum θ = 0 par hota hai, to d sin θ = nλ se n = 0; yeh zero order hai.

blocks.prompt:
15.1 Can Huygens' Principle be applied on sound and water waves? Explain briefly.
Kya Huygens' Principle sound aur paani ki waves par lagu ho sakta hai? Mukhtasar wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Haan. Huygens' principle har wave ke liye geometrical tareeqa hai: wavefront ka har point secondary wavelets (chhoti lehrein) ka source banta hai jo wave ki speed se phailti hain, aur un ka envelope (sab ko chhoone wali surface) naya wavefront hota hai. Sound aur paani ki waves ke bhi wavefronts hote hain, is liye un ka phailao, reflection, refraction aur diffraction bhi is se samjhaya ja sakta hai.

blocks.prompt:
15.2 Why interference pattern is produced due to headlights of a car? Explain briefly.
Car ki headlights se interference pattern kyun (nahin) banta? Mukhtasar wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Asal mein car ki headlights se interference pattern nahin banta. Dono headlights alag alag sources hain: coherent nahin (phase difference tezi se aur be-tarteeb badalta hai) aur bohat si wavelengths deti hain. Is liye pattern itni tezi se badalta hai ke nazar nahin aata; sirf yaksaan roshni dikhti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ka sawal poochta hai ke headlights se interference pattern kyun BANTA hai. Asal mein pattern nahin banta, kyun ke dono headlights coherent nahin. Sawal yun hona chahiye: 'interference pattern kyun nahin banta'; upar ka jawab yahi samjhata hai.

blocks.prompt:
15.3 Why interference pattern is observed on soap bubbles but not on window glass or windscreens of cars?
Sabun ke bulbulon par interference pattern kyun dikhta hai magar khirki ke sheeshe ya car ki windscreen par kyun nahin?
blocks.explanation: Sabun ki film bohat patli hoti hai (motai roshni ki wavelength jitni), is liye aglay aur pichhlay surface se reflect hone wali roshni ka path difference chand wavelengths hota hai aur alag rang alag jagah mazboot hote hain. Khirki ka sheesha aur windscreen millimetre mote hain; path difference hazaron wavelengths ka hota hai, sab rangon ki fringes aapas mein mil jati hain aur bohat qareeb hoti hain, is liye pattern nazar nahin aata.

blocks.prompt:
15.4 If the whole apparatus of Young's double slit experiment is submerged in water, what will be the effect on fringes?
Agar Young's double slit ka poora apparatus paani mein dubo diya jaye to fringes par kya asar hoga?
blocks.explanation: Paani mein roshni ki wavelength λw = λ/n ho jati hai (n ≈ 1.33). Kyun ke Δy = Lλ/d, fringe width n guna kam ho jati hai (hawa ke muqable mein taqreeban 3/4). Fringes qareeb aa jati hain; central fringe roshan hi rehti hai.

blocks.prompt:
15.5 Compare the Double slit experimental arrangements for light and sound waves, similarities and differences.
Roshni aur sound ke double slit experiment ke intizaam ka muqabla karein: milti julti baatein aur farq.
blocks.explanation: Dono do-sources wale interference experiment hain: dono mein ek hi wavelength ke coherent sources chahiye; maxima wahan jahan path difference mλ ho aur minima jahan (m + ½)λ ho; Δy = Lλ/d dono par lagu hai.

rows: Coherence: ek laser beam do slits se do hisson mein
Coherence: dono loudspeakers ek hi signal generator se jure
Slits ka faasla: millimetre ka chhota hissa
Speakers ka faasla: taqreeban ek metre (λ centimetres se metres)
Kaan ya microphone ko idhar udhar le ja kar suna jata hai
Pattern: oonchi (loud) aur dheemi (quiet) awaz ki jagahen

blocks.prompt:
15.6 For a diffraction grating, what are the advantages of using (a) many slits, (b) narrow slits and (c) closely spaced slits? Explain
Diffraction grating mein (a) zyada slits, (b) patli slits aur (c) qareeb qareeb slits ke kya faide hain? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation:
(a) Zyada slits: maxima bohat tez (sharp), patle aur roshan ho jate hain, is liye un ke angles aur wavelengths bohat durust naapi jati hain.
(b) Patli slits: har slit roshni ko zyada phailati (diffract karti) hai, roshni bare angles tak pohanchti hai aur oonche orders bhi nazar aate hain.
(c) Qareeb slits (chhota d): sin θ = nλ/d se orders bare angles par aur ek doosre se door hote hain, spectrum zyada phailta hai aur naapna aasan hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
15.7 How the number of orders in a given diffraction grating can be increased?
Kisi grating mein orders ki tadaad kaise barhai ja sakti hai?
blocks.explanation: d sin θ = nλ aur sin θ ≤ 1 se sab se ooncha order n(max) = d/λ (poora number). Is liye orders barhane ke liye zyada spacing d wali grating (kam lines per mm) ya chhoti wavelength ki roshni istemal karein.

blocks.prompt:
15.8 Explain how the pattern would change if red light is replaced with blue light in a given diffraction grating?
Grating par laal (red) roshni ki jagah neeli (blue) roshni dalein to pattern kaise badle ga?
blocks.explanation: Neeli roshni ki wavelength laal se chhoti hai. sin θ = nλ/d se neeli roshni ka har order chhote angle par, central maximum ke qareeb aata hai, yani lines qareeb ho jati hain (kam phailao). Central maximum (n = 0) θ = 0 par hi rehta hai, aur n(max) = d/λ barhne se zyada orders nazar aa sakte hain.

blocks.prompt:
15.9 Why central spot in Newton's rings is dark?
Newton's rings ka beech wala spot dark kyun hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Beech mein lens glass plate ko chhoota hai, is liye hawa ki film ki motai aur geometrical path difference zero hai. Lekin neeche wali (hawa se glass) surface se reflect hone wali roshni mein half-cycle (λ/2) ka phase shift hota hai. Dono reflected waves antiphase (ulte phase) mein hoti hain aur destructive interference karti hain, is liye beech dark hota hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Half-cycle phase shift tab hota hai jab roshni kam refractive index (hawa) se zyada refractive index (glass) wali surface se reflect ho. Upar wali (glass se hawa) reflection mein yeh shift nahin hota. Is liye beech mein path difference zero hone ke bawajood waves ulte phase mein milti hain.
Constructed Response Questions (tafseeli jawab wale sawal)

blocks.prompt:
15.1 Light sometimes describes as rays and sometimes as waves. Construct diagrams to explain differences in both.
Roshni ko kabhi rays aur kabhi waves ke tor par bayan kiya jata hai. Dono ka farq diagrams bana kar samjhaein.
blocks.explanation:
Ray diagram: roshni ko seedhi lines aur teer (arrow) se dikhayen jo chalne ki simt batayen, jaise plane mirror par ray gir kar angle i = angle r se palatti hai, ya parallel rays convex lens se guzar kar focus par milti hain. Rays seedha chalna, saaye (shadows), reflection aur refraction samjhati hain (geometrical optics).
Wave diagram: wavefronts banayen (plane wave ke liye parallel lines, point source ke liye circles), aapas mein ek wavelength λ ke faasle par, aur ray ka teer un par perpendicular (amood) banayen. Patle gap par wavefronts ko aage gol ho kar phailta dikhayen (Huygens' wavelets). Waves interference, diffraction aur saaye mein roshni ka murna samjhati hain.
Ray energy ke chalne ki simt hai aur hamesha wavefronts par perpendicular hoti hai.

rows: Roshni seedhi lines aur teer se
Roshni wavefronts (lines ya circles) se, ek λ ke faasle par
Sirf chalne ki simt dikhata hai
Phase, wavelength aur phailao dikhata hai
Seedha chalna, saaye, reflection, refraction samjhata hai
Interference, diffraction (aur reflection, refraction bhi) samjhata hai
Fringes ya saaye mein murna nahin samjha sakta
Fringes aur patli slits se phailao samjhata hai

blocks.prompt:
15.2 Suppose white light is falling on a double slit arrangement, such that one slit is covered with red filter (400 nm) and other is with blue filter (650 nm), explain what would be observed on the screen?
Safaid roshni double slit par parti hai; ek slit par laal filter (400 nm) aur doosri par neela filter (650 nm) hai. Screen par kya nazar aaye ga?
blocks.explanation: Ab dono slits alag wavelengths (laal aur neeli) ki roshni bhejti hain; dono sources ki frequency alag hai is liye woh coherent nahin hain, phase difference ek jaisa nahin rehta. Is liye mustaqil interference fringes nahin banti. Screen par dono slits ki laal aur neeli roshni aapas mein mil kar taqreeban yaksaan mila jula (magenta/jamni) rang ka hissa dikhati hai; har rang sirf apni slit ke diffraction se phailta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab laal filter (400 nm) aur neela filter (650 nm) likhti hai. Wavelengths ulat gayi hain: laal roshni taqreeban 650 nm aur neeli taqreeban 400-450 nm hoti hai. Jawab nahin badalta: dono slits alag wavelengths deti hain, is liye fringes nahin banti.

blocks.prompt:
15.3 What will be the effect on width and brightness of the fringes in a double slit interference experiment if we decrease the width of one slit to half keeping all other thing same?
Double slit experiment mein ek slit ki chaurai aadhi kar di jaye (baqi sab wohi) to fringes ki width aur roshni par kya asar hoga?
blocks.explanation:
Width: fringe width Δy = Lλ/d slit ki chaurai par depend nahin karti, is liye fringe width wohi rehti hai.
Roshni (brightness): patli slit aadhi roshni guzarti hai, is ki wave ka amplitude kam (taqreeban A/√2) ho jata hai. Amplitudes barabar nahin rehte, is liye:
- roshan fringes kam roshan: (A + 0.71A)² ≈ 2.9A², pehle 4A²;
- dark fringes poori tarah dark nahin: (A − 0.71A)² ≈ 0.09A², pehle 0.
Roshan aur andheri fringes ka contrast (farq) kam ho jata hai (chapter: barabar na hone wale amplitudes contrast kam karte hain).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Intensity (roshni) amplitude ke square ke mutanasib hai: I ∝ A². Aadhi roshni ka matlab intensity aadhi, yani amplitude A/√2 ≈ 0.71A. Roshan jagah par amplitudes jurte hain (A + 0.71A), andheri jagah par ghatte hain (A − 0.71A); is liye andheri jagah ab bilkul zero nahin hoti.

blocks.prompt:
15.4 Why can we readily observe diffraction effects for sound wave and water waves, but not for light? Is this because light travels so much faster than these other waves? Explain.
Sound aur paani ki waves ka diffraction aasani se kyun dikhta hai magar roshni ka kyun nahin? Kya is ki wajah roshni ki bohat zyada speed hai? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diffraction tab wazeh hota hai jab gap ya rukawat ka size wavelength ke barabar ho. Sound waves (λ taqreeban 2 cm se 17 m) aur paani ki waves (centimetres se metres) ki wavelength hamare ird gird ke darwazon, khirkiyon aur gaps jitni hai, is liye woh khoob murti hain. Roshni ki λ sirf 400-700 nm hai, aam suraakhon se bohat chhoti, is liye us ka murna bohat kam hai aur dekhne ke liye bohat patli slits chahiye.
Wajah roshni ki zyada speed nahin. Diffraction λ aur suraakh ke size ke muqable par depend karta hai, speed par nahin. Roshni tez hai magar us ki frequency itni zyada hai ke λ = v/f bohat chhoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
15.5 What is the significance of path difference in deriving Bragg's equation?
Bragg's equation nikalne mein path difference ki kya ahmiyat hai?
blocks.explanation:
Bragg ki derivation mein X-rays ek doosre se d faasle par parallel atomic planes (aytomon ki satahon) se reflect hoti hain. Neeche wali plane se reflect hone wali ray jaate hue d sin θ aur aate hue d sin θ zyada chalti hai, is liye path difference = 2d sin θ.
Mazboot reflected beam sirf tab banti hai jab reflected rays aapas mein mazboot hon, yani path difference poori wavelengths ke barabar ho: 2d sin θ = nλ (Bragg's equation).
Yun path difference naape ja sakne wale angle θ aur wavelength λ ko planes ke faasle d se jorta hai; is se samajh aata hai ke reflection sirf khaas angles par kyun hoti hai, aur angle se crystal ka faasla (aur structure) maloom hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
15.1 Coherent light of wavelength 500 nm is incident on two very narrow and closely spaced slits. The interference pattern is observed on a very tall screen that is 2.00 m from the slits. Near the center of the screen the separation between two adjacent interference maxima is 3.53 cm. What is the distance on the screen between the m = 49 and m = 50 maxima?
(500 nm wavelength ki coherent roshni do patli, qareeb slits par parti hai. Screen slits se 2.00 m door aur bohat oonchi hai. Screen ke beech ke qareeb do saath wale maxima ka faasla 3.53 cm hai. m = 49 aur m = 50 maxima ka screen par faasla kya hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): λ = 500 nm = 5.00 × 10⁻⁷ m, L = 2.00 m, Δy (beech ke qareeb) = 3.53 cm = 3.53 × 10⁻² m
Maloom karna (Required): y₅₀ − y₄₉
Step 1 (slits ka faasla): Δy = Lλ/d, to d = Lλ/Δy = (2.00 m × 5.00 × 10⁻⁷ m)/(3.53 × 10⁻² m) = 2.83 × 10⁻⁵ m
Step 2: m = 49 aur 50 ke angles bare hain, is liye y = Lλm/d nahin chalega; d sin θ = mλ aur y = L tan θ (Eq. 15.3) lagayen.
m = 49: sin θ₄₉ = 49λ/d = 49 × 5.00 × 10⁻⁷ / 2.83 × 10⁻⁵ = 0.865, θ₄₉ = 59.9°
y₄₉ = L tan θ₄₉ = 2.00 m × tan 59.9° = 3.45 m
m = 50: sin θ₅₀ = 50λ/d = 0.883, θ₅₀ = 61.9°
y₅₀ = 2.00 m × tan 61.9° = 3.75 m
Step 3: y₅₀ − y₄₉ = 3.75 m − 3.45 m = 0.307 m
Jawab: taqreeban 30.7 cm (3.53 cm se kahin zyada, kyun ke beech se door chhote angle wala formula kaam nahin karta).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Beech ke qareeb (chhote angle) fringes barabar faasle par hoti hain: Δy = Lλ/d. Lekin m = 49, 50 par angle taqreeban 60° hai; wahan sin θ aur tan θ barabar nahin, is liye pehle d sin θ = mλ se angle nikalein, phir y = L tan θ. Is liye jawab 3.53 cm nahin, 30.7 cm aata hai.

blocks.prompt:
15.2 Young's experiment is performed with light from excited helium atoms λ = 502 nm. Fringes are measured carefully on a screen 1.20 m away from the double slit, and the center of the 20th fringe (not counting the central bright fringe) is found to be 10.6 mm from the center of the central bright fringe. What is the separation of the two slits?
(Helium ki roshni λ = 502 nm se Young's experiment. Screen 1.20 m door hai aur 20th fringe (central ke ilawa) ka markaz central bright fringe se 10.6 mm door hai. Slits ka faasla kya hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): λ = 502 nm = 5.02 × 10⁻⁷ m, L = 1.20 m, m = 20, y₂₀ = 10.6 mm = 1.06 × 10⁻² m
Maloom karna (Required): slits ka faasla d
Formula: yₘ = mLλ/d, to d = mLλ/yₘ
d = (20 × 1.20 m × 5.02 × 10⁻⁷ m)/(1.06 × 10⁻² m)
d = (1.205 × 10⁻⁵ m²)/(1.06 × 10⁻² m) = 1.14 × 10⁻³ m
Jawab: d = 1.14 mm

blocks.prompt:
15.3 Coherent light with wavelength 450 nm falls on a pair of slits. On a screen 1.80 m away, the distance between dark fringes is 3.90 mm. What is the slit separation?
(450 nm ki coherent roshni do slits par. 1.80 m door screen par dark fringes ka faasla 3.90 mm hai. Slits ka faasla kya hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): λ = 450 nm = 4.50 × 10⁻⁷ m, L = 1.80 m, dark fringes ka faasla Δy = 3.90 mm = 3.90 × 10⁻³ m
Maloom karna (Required): slits ka faasla d
Saath wali dark fringes ka faasla bhi wohi Δy hai jo bright fringes ka: Δy = Lλ/d, to d = Lλ/Δy
d = (1.80 m × 4.50 × 10⁻⁷ m)/(3.90 × 10⁻³ m)
d = (8.10 × 10⁻⁷ m²)/(3.90 × 10⁻³ m) = 2.08 × 10⁻⁴ m
Jawab: d = 0.208 mm

blocks.prompt:
15.4 Two slits spaced 0.450 mm apart are placed 75.0 cm from a screen. What is the distance between the second and third dark lines of the interference pattern on the screen when the slits are illuminated with coherent light with a wavelength of 500 nm?
(0.450 mm faasle wali do slits screen se 75.0 cm door hain, roshni 500 nm. Doosri aur teesri dark lines ka faasla kya hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): d = 0.450 mm = 4.50 × 10⁻⁴ m, L = 75.0 cm = 0.750 m, λ = 500 nm = 5.00 × 10⁻⁷ m
Maloom karna (Required): doosri aur teesri dark lines ka faasla
Saath wali dark lines (d sin θ = (m + ½)λ) ek fringe width ke faasle par hoti hain: Δy = Lλ/d
Δy = (0.750 m × 5.00 × 10⁻⁷ m)/(4.50 × 10⁻⁴ m)
Δy = (3.75 × 10⁻⁷ m²)/(4.50 × 10⁻⁴ m) = 8.33 × 10⁻⁴ m
Jawab: 0.833 mm

blocks.prompt:
15.5 Two very narrow slits are spaced 1.80 mm apart and are placed 35.0 cm from a screen. What is the distance between the first and second dark lines of the interference pattern when the slits are illuminated with coherent light of wavelength 550 nm?
(1.80 mm faasle wali do slits screen se 35.0 cm door hain, roshni 550 nm. Pehli aur doosri dark lines ka faasla kya hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): d = 1.80 mm = 1.80 × 10⁻³ m, L = 35.0 cm = 0.350 m, λ = 550 nm = 5.50 × 10⁻⁷ m
Maloom karna (Required): pehli aur doosri dark lines ka faasla
Saath wali dark lines ek fringe width ke faasle par hoti hain: Δy = Lλ/d
Δy = (0.350 m × 5.50 × 10⁻⁷ m)/(1.80 × 10⁻³ m)
Δy = (1.925 × 10⁻⁷ m²)/(1.80 × 10⁻³ m) = 1.07 × 10⁻⁴ m
Jawab: 0.107 mm

blocks.prompt:
15.6 Monochromatic light is at normal incidence on a plane transmission grating. The first-order maximum in the interference pattern is at an angle of 11.3°. What is the angular position of the fourth-order maximum?
(Plane transmission grating par roshni seedhi (normal) parti hai. First-order maximum 11.3° par hai. Fourth-order maximum kis angle par hoga?)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): n = 1 par θ₁ = 11.3°; maloom karna θ₄ (n = 4)
Formula: d sin θ = nλ
n = 1 ke liye: sin θ₁ = λ/d = sin 11.3° = 0.196
n = 4 ke liye: sin θ₄ = 4λ/d = 4 × 0.196 = 0.784
θ₄ = sin⁻¹(0.784) = 51.6°
Jawab: fourth-order maximum 51.6° par hai (4 × 11.3° nahin, kyun ke n ke mutanasib sin θ hai, θ nahin).

blocks.prompt:
15.7 If a diffraction grating produces a third-order bright spot for red light of wavelength 700 nm at 65° from the central maximum, at what angle will the second-order bright spot be for violet light of wavelength 400 nm?
(Grating 700 nm laal roshni ka third-order bright spot 65° par deti hai. 400 nm violet roshni ka second-order bright spot kis angle par hoga?)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): laal: n = 3, λ = 700 nm = 7.00 × 10⁻⁷ m, θ = 65°; violet: n = 2, λ = 400 nm = 4.00 × 10⁻⁷ m
Maloom karna (Required): violet second order ka angle θ
Step 1 (grating spacing): d sin θ = nλ, to d = nλ/sin θ = (3 × 7.00 × 10⁻⁷ m)/sin 65° = (2.10 × 10⁻⁶ m)/0.906 = 2.32 × 10⁻⁶ m
Step 2: sin θ = nλ/d = (2 × 4.00 × 10⁻⁷ m)/(2.32 × 10⁻⁶ m) = 0.345
θ = sin⁻¹(0.345) = 20.2°
Jawab: central maximum se taqreeban 20.2°.
